  1. To establish the mind for Heaven and Earth; to secure the destiny of the people; to continue the interrupted learning of the past sages; to open peace for all ages.
    Zhang Zai
    Philosophy
  2. I ask the channel how it can be so clear — because fresh water keeps flowing from its source.
    Zhu Xi
    Learning
  3. Knowledge is the directing idea of action; action is the effort of knowledge. Knowledge is the beginning of action; action is the completion of knowledge.
    Wang Yangming
    Knowledge
  4. There has never been one who truly knows and yet does not act. If one knows but does not act, that is simply not yet knowing.
    Wang Yangming
    Knowledge
  5. Extend the innate good knowing.
    Wang Yangming
    Knowledge
  6. Those who in ancient or modern times achieved great enterprises and profound learning must pass through three realms: first, standing alone atop a high tower after the west wind withers the green trees, gazing to the end of the road at heaven's edge; second, the belt growing looser without regret, wasting away for the beloved; third, searching a thousand times in the crowd, then suddenly turning — and finding that person standing where the lanterns grow sparse.
    Wang Guowei
    Learning
  7. The two sayings I have found most useful in life are these: responsibility, and delight.… What I speak of today as respect for one's work is responsibility; delight in one's work is interest. I deeply believe that a reasonable human life should be like this.
    Liang Qichao
    Responsibility
  8. Every occupation has its interest — if only you keep at it, interest will naturally arise.
    Liang Qichao
    Philosophy

    Hu Shi
